items.title: Strategy pauses bitcoin buys, repurchases $205 million of STRC preferred shares
items.summary: Strategy's bitcoin holdings account for roughly 4% of the total supply cap, with $3.9 billion in paper gains.

items.title: AI giant Anthropic files for blockbuster IPO
items.summary: The maker of Claude reported $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss as it aims to price its offering in mid-November.

items.title: Nexus Mutual vs. Firelight: Who Files Claims and Gets Paid
items.summary: Kraken’s Firelight arrangement caps cover at $100,000 per depositor address per period, while direct Nexus buyers choose their amount and must file their own claims.

items.title: HOOD’s prediction markets to add $1.7B to  revenue, exceed crypto by 2028: Bernstein
items.summary: Bernstein analysts raised Robinhood’s revenue estimates through 2026 and 2028, while maintaining their HOOD price target unchanged at $160.
